## Highlights

- The pairwise covariance workflow example accepts portfolios with numeric asset identifiers. Previously it could report mismatched labels and withhold portfolio risk for a complete, positive semidefinite covariance matrix. [#108](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/108)
- The liquidity aggregates share a single NULL-row check across grouped and window execution, with additional regression coverage. Results are unchanged. [#106](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/106)

## Upgrading from 0.3.2

0.3.3 is a patch release for DuckDB v2.0.0. Version constraints that select the 0.3 line pick it up. It does not change any function signature, return type or result.

1. Update the extension with `FORCE INSTALL finance FROM community;` (or `UPDATE EXTENSIONS (finance);`), then `LOAD finance;`.
2. Repositories that copied the pairwise covariance example should compare their copy with the updated `examples/pairwise_covariance.sql`, as described under [Bug Fixes](#bug-fixes).

## Bug Fixes

- The pairwise covariance example compared asset labels in numeric order, while `fin_cov_matrix` orders labels as strings. For asset identifiers such as `2`, `10` and `20`, the example reported `labels_match = false` and suppressed portfolio risk. The example now converts asset identifiers to `VARCHAR` before joins, duplicate checks and ordering, which matches the matrix and portfolio functions. Label formatting remains significant: the string `'02'` does not match the integer `2`. The data source compatibility guide documents these label semantics. [#108](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/108)

## Maintenance

- `fin_vwap`, `fin_ad_line`, `fin_amihud_illiquidity` and `fin_kyle_lambda` share one complete-row NULL check in their grouped and ungrouped callbacks. Each function keeps its own domain validation, and results are unchanged. New regression cases cover NULL values paired with non-finite values, grouped and window execution, and invalid complete rows. [#106](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/106)
- The covariance workflow tests include a four-asset panel with numeric identifiers and check every covariance entry and the portfolio variance against independently computed values. [#108](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/108)
- Source, community manifest and package metadata are aligned at 0.3.3.
